advisor_identified: Associate professor of history at Carleton University, specializing in modern France, youth history, and women’s and gender history; co-supervisor of Nicole Marion’s 2017 dissertation.

doctorate.title: The Politics of Youth: Communists and Catholics in Interwar France

evidence.says: Carleton’s faculty profile identifies Susan Whitney as an associate professor of history with a PhD from Rutgers. It lists Nicole Marion’s Canada’s Disarmers: The Complicated Struggle Against Nuclear Weapons, 1959–1963 (PhD, 2017), co-supervised with Norman Hillmer, matching the entry’s student dissertation.
Histoire de l’éducation 75–76 (1997), bibliography entry 119, records Susan Brewster Whitney, The Politics of Youth: Communists and Catholics in Interwar France, PhD, Rutgers University, 1994.

notes: The faculty profile establishes the advisor’s identity and Rutgers doctorate; the independent scholarly bibliography supplies the matching dissertation title and 1994 year. These agree with linked AHA record 61583.
